1..25
ok 1 intent_agents script is executable
ok 2 intent_agents script syntax is valid
ok 3 intent agents help shows the canon summary
ok 4 init writes root AGENTS.md as a regular file, not intent/llm/AGENTS.md
ok 5 init --template elixir writes root AGENTS.md and keeps RULES/ARCHITECTURE under intent/llm/
ok 6 sync replaces a pre-existing symlink with a real file
ok 7 sync is idempotent -- two consecutive runs produce byte-identical output
ok 8 sync renders installed skills and subagents from .claude/
ok 9 sync renders fallbacks when .claude/ is absent
ok 10 validate passes on a clean project (regular file at root)
ok 11 validate warns on a legacy symlink (exit 0, warning on output)
ok 12 generate dispatcher self-loads project context (regression: bare PROJECT_ROOT)
ok 13 generated Rule Library section routes through the CLI, not a local rules path
ok 14 enriched content includes canon section pointers (critic, rules, extensions, hooks, FAQ)
ok 15 init --template rust creates root AGENTS.md despite template having none
ok 16 sync renders skills and subagents installed in HOME/.claude
ok 17 init --template _default produces an AGENTS.md that passes validate
ok 18 the shell prerequisite is gated on the declared languages, not asserted for every project
ok 19 an empty Prerequisites block says so rather than leaving a bare heading
ok 20 a stray marker file does not assert a toolchain the project never declared
ok 21 a declared language is stated even when its marker file is elsewhere
ok 22 lua and swift get prerequisite lines, which they never had
ok 23 build and test commands still follow the marker file, not the declaration
ok 24 agents sync --check reports staleness without writing
ok 25 agents sync --check ignores the generated-by date
